# 引源 GEO (YinYuan GEO)

> Generative Engine Optimization SaaS marketing site for brands that want to be named in CN generative engines.

## Product
- Name: 引源 GEO 投放台 (YinYuan GEO Platform)
- Flow: entity card → engine packs → publish to channels → monitor mention rate
- Engines (execution): 豆包, DeepSeek, 智谱, 百度, 通义千问
- Intel layer (optional): 元宝, Kimi, and more
- Owner: Kinnv
- Ops: Grok Bot CEO
- Private product repo (text only): github.com/yjz8521/geo-platform

## Plans (codes; list prices on site are draft)
- free — trial quotas
- starter — small team + API
- pro — webhooks, reports, advanced attribution
- enterprise — high quotas, soft caps, custom

## Site pages
- / — product overview
- /pricing — draft SaaS plans
- /sponsor — early cash sponsor slots
- /demo — trial request
- /about — owner & ops
